hook_line: INDIA'S MIDDLE CLASS BORROWS FASTER THAN INCOMES

hook_stat.sub: Consumer debt as a share of GDP — a record

stats.label: Surge in household borrowing in the year through March
About — of household income went to servicing debt, up from 10-11% for much of the previous decade
Basis points of further RBI rate hikes economists expect in coming months

diaspora_bullets: Excluding mortgage debt, CLSA estimates Indian consumers are among the most constrained in the world
Bad-loan ratios at banks are near multi-decade lows, with little evidence so far of widespread repayment stress
news_summary: Household borrowing in India surged 36% in the year through March, taking consumer debt to a record 46% of GDP, while borrowing rose roughly four times as fast as disposable income in 2025-26.
payoff: Economists expect another 75-100 basis points of RBI rate hikes in coming months.
